title: How Pep Guardiola's Legacy Influences the Manchester Derby
seoTitle: How Pep Guardiola's Legacy Influences the Manchester Derby
subtitle: Understand why Pep Guardiola's style resurfaces in the Premier League classic
excerpt: The classic match between Manchester United and Manchester City, played at Old Trafford, highlights the influence of Pep Guardiola's playing style, now under.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The classic match between Manchester United and Manchester City, held last Sunday, highlighted how Enzo Maresca's project incorporates principles associated with Pep Guardiola. The clash, valid for the fourth round of the Premier League, ended with a 1-0 victory for City, despite playing with one less player.

What the Derby Reveals About Pep Guardiola's Philosophy

According to HolaNews' coverage, the City manager arrived at the club with the mission to “aspire to everything, as the club did under Pep Guardiola's command.” This reference indicates that the style of ball possession, high pressing, and the search for goals from different areas continue to be the guiding principles for the team.

How City Maintained Their Advantageous Performance

Even after Phil Foden's expulsion for an aggression against Bruno Fernandes, Manchester City managed to impose their rhythm. Erling Haaland scored the only goal of the game, while goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma made a decisive save in the final minutes, securing the victory.

Impact of Enzo Maresca's Leadership

The HolaNews report highlights that City's performance is “a declaration of intent in Enzo Maresca's new project.” The newly arrived coach already demonstrates the ability to keep the team focused on its objectives, following the work ethic that marked the Pep Guardiola era.

Manchester United's Reaction

United, led by Michael Carrick, sought to react to their good European form but ended up drawing 2-2 against Everton before the classic. In the Old Trafford clash, the team couldn't overcome City's pressure, even with notable performances from Bruno Fernandes and Lisandro Martínez, who were involved in an incident that led to Foden's expulsion.

Conclusions for the Premier League Scenario

The result keeps Manchester City with a perfect twelve points, strengthening their position in the title race alongside Arsenal, who also have twelve points. The performance demonstrates that the playing identity associated with Pep Guardiola still influences tactical decisions and results, even with changes in the coaching staff.
